title: Spinach and Tomato Dal (Indian Lentil Soup)
description: This red lentil, spinach, and tomato dal (Indian lentil soup) recipe makes a hearty and healthy dish that leaves you satisfied without overfilling you.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt, plus more for seasoning

steps.text: Bring 4 cups water and lentils to a boil in a saucepan; stir in salt. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer 10 minutes. Skim off any foam that forms; continue to simmer until lentils are tender, about 1 hour.

Heat oil in a separate saucepan. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds; cook until they start to splatter, 2 to 3 minutes. Add onion, garlic, and turmeric; cook and stir until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in spinach, tomato, and cayenne pepper; cook until spinach wilts and tomato is tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir cooked lentils and cilantro into spinach mixture; bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes. Taste; adjust salt and water according to preferences.
